doan_van.ten: Truyện — Cuộc điện thoại quan trọng
doan_van.noi_dung:
Yesterday morning, I phoned a large business in London regarding an urgent job application. I wanted to confirm the exact time of my interview before the weekend. A polite receptionist answered my call and asked me to hold on for a moment. She tried to put me through to the manager, Mr Nam, but he was not available at that time. Therefore, she kindly offered to take a message for him. I left my telephone number and asked if he could call back later in the afternoon. I also apologised for calling during their busy morning office hours.

Two hours later, I received a short email from Mr Nam about the meeting. He wanted to arrange our discussion for Friday morning at ten o'clock. In his email message, he asked me to reply quickly and attach my updated CV and documents. I decided to forward his email to my brother, who knew the city centre very well. In my response, I asked about the location of the main office building. I thanked Mr Nam in advance for his help and told him that I look forward to meeting the whole team soon. I felt very well prepared for the upcoming interview.

- **urgent** /ˈɜːdʒənt/ — âm /ɜː/ dài.
- **Could you** nói nhanh thành /ˈkʊdʒə/ — nghe như “cu-jơ”.
luu_y:
**① Câu hỏi gián tiếp KHÔNG đảo ngữ, KHÔNG dùng do/does/did.**

- ❌ Could you tell me where **is** the station?
- ✅ Could you tell me where the station **is**?
- ❌ Do you know what time **does** it start?
- ✅ Do you know what time it **starts**?

> Đây là lỗi ngữ pháp phổ biến ngay cả ở band 6.0. Quy tắc: sau “Could you tell me / Do you know”, câu trở về **trật tự câu kể** (S + V).

**② Câu hỏi Yes/No gián tiếp dùng if hoặc whether:**
*Is he here?* → Could you tell me **if** he is here?

**③ “This is…” khi tự giới thiệu qua điện thoại, không dùng “I am”.**
❌ I am David. → ✅ **This is** David. (qua điện thoại)

**④ Cụm điện thoại cố định — học nguyên khối:**
hold on · put you through · call back · take a message · the line is busy · you’ve got the wrong number

**⑤ look forward to + V-ING** (to ở đây là giới từ, không phải “to V”):
❌ I look forward to meet you. → ✅ I look forward to **meeting** you.

> Nhóm tương tự: be used to + V-ing, in addition to + V-ing.

**⑥ Email trang trọng:** mở đầu *Dear Mr./Ms. + họ*, kết *Best regards / Kind regards*. Không viết “Dear Mr. Nam” nếu Nam là tên riêng — dùng họ.
meo:
- Câu hỏi gián tiếp: **“hỏi lịch sự thì câu hết hỏi”** — bỏ đảo ngữ, bỏ do/does/did, trở về trật tự kể.
- Nhớ “look forward to + V-ing” bằng cách thay thử danh từ: *I look forward to **the meeting*** — thấy được danh từ thì phải là V-ing, không phải V nguyên thể.
- Bộ 6 cụm điện thoại ở mục ④ — học thuộc là xử lý được 90% cuộc gọi công việc.
